cues.txt: Did you know that around 50% of English
is made up of around 100 words? Yep.
Around half of everyday English uses the
same 100 words again and again. This is
excellent news for English learners. I
know that learning another language can
feel very overwhelming because there are
so many words to learn, but here is a
great place to start. So, today, in less
than 20 minutes, I'm going to teach you
all 100 words that make up 50% of spoken
English with clear pronunciation and
lots of natural examples so that you can
start following conversations and feel
much more confident when you speak. And
to help you even further, I've put
together a complete PDF guide that you
can download for free. These 100 words
are far too important to only see once.

100 words, including pronunciation

some interactive exercises. Everything
